events.text:
Thank you, Hana. I've verified your account and looked into order Q-7501 from Big Slice Pizza.

The courier's records show the order was left at your door at 7:02 PM, and there is a photo of the bag at the door of apartment 1204. Because of that photo proof, I can't issue a refund or credit myself. I've escalated the case to a human specialist (reference ESC-700), who will follow up with you within 24 hours. I've included your account of the missing order and your check at 7:10 PM.

If anything else comes up in the meantime, let me know.

Wait, you're saying there's a photo of the bag at my door? I'm in apartment 1204 and there was nothing there when I looked at 7:10. Packages have gone missing in this building before, so I don't trust that photo. I want a full refund, not a 24 hour wait for someone to maybe look at it.

I understand why you're frustrated, and I'm sorry you didn't get your food. I can see why the photo is hard to accept when nothing was at your door at 7:10.

I can't issue the refund myself, though. Our policy requires that a delivery with photo proof of handoff be reviewed by a specialist, not refunded at the agent level. The case is already with a specialist under reference ESC-700. In your report, please include that you checked at 7:10 PM and that packages have gone missing in your building before, since that context will help their review.

If you'd like to speak with a person directly, I can request that as well. Is there anything else I can help with on this order?

I get that you can't refund it yourself, but I'm not going to just sit and wait 24 hours hoping someone believes me. I want my money back for a pizza I never got. Can you at least tell me the specialist will actually issue the refund if they agree with me?

I can't promise that. The specialist will review the delivery dispute, and I don't know what they'll decide, so I can't tell you a refund is guaranteed.

What I can tell you is what's already happened: the case is open under ESC-700, and the specialist will follow up within 24 hours. I haven't issued any refund or credit, and I can't do that for this order under the current delivery record.

If you want to speak with a person right away, I can flag that request too. Would you like me to do that?

Yes, please flag that. I'd rather talk to a person now than wait around. And put in the report that I've had packages go missing in this building before, because that's the whole reason I don't trust that photo.
